feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: France and Romania lost more nuclear-power capacity to drought this summer than previously reported
entry.summary: France took two more reactors offline in late July, adding over 5 gigawatts to an already-reported June shutdown, as river levels fell too low to safely accept cooling water. — Sources: Anadolu Agency, 'France shuts down 3 nuclear reactors as drought lowers river flows', 2026 · Industrial Info Resources, August 2026 · Associated Press wire reporting, July-August 2026

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany dipped again after two days of recovery
entry.summary: Germany's main shipping gauge read 18 centimetres on 14 October, down from 20 centimetres the day before. — Sources: Kaub gauge readings, direct fetch via rivercruise.ai, 14 October 2026

entry.title: Indonesia's fire-hotspot count kept swinging for a third consecutive day past its peak
entry.summary: The Ministry of Forestry recorded 12,176 hotspots nationally on 11 October, filling in a day between two already-reported counts and confirming the fire activity behind the region's haze rose and fell for three consecutive days after its 8 October peak. — Sources: Indonesia Ministry of Forestry, via databoks.katadata.co.id, 11 October 2026

entry.title: Singapore's worst air quality of the 2026 season was higher than previously reported, and has since eased
entry.summary: The 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index reached 191 in central Singapore on 9 October, the actual high point of the season. — Sources: Must Share News, 9 October 2026 · National Environment Agency Singapore, via theindependent.sg, 11-12 October 2026

entry.title: Malaysia widened school closures as haze crossed a lowered threshold
entry.summary: Nine air-quality monitoring stations exceeded the unhealthy threshold on 9 October, with schools closed across Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya and five states. — Sources: Khaleej Times, 9 October 2026 · Al Jazeera, 9 October 2026
